component.name: Max Potion
component.summary: Offline Pokémon save editor with real-time legality checking

description.p: Max Potion is an all-in-one Pokémon save file editor, written for Linux first and also available on other platforms. It works entirely offline: the data it needs travels inside the app.

ul.li: Edit Pokémon, trainer data, bag and Pokédex across the generations supported by PKHeX.Core
Movesets and learnsets built in, with recommended sets
Real-time legality checking, with explanations and automatic fixes
Interface in 13 languages, with the game-data language chosen independently

description.p: Built on PKHeX.Core. Always keep a backup of your save file before editing. Pokémon is a trademark of Nintendo, Creatures Inc. and GAME FREAK inc.; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
